name: Roland's Doom
summary: Nightbane worgen prowl the abandoned mine at Roland's Doom, east of the Rotting Orchard in southeastern Duskwood.

sections.title: A Den of Shadows and Savagery
sections.body: East of the Rotting Orchard, Roland's Doom lies among the ridges of southeastern Duskwood. The mine has stood idle for a long while. Now Nightbane worgen use its tunnels as a staging ground, led by such chieftains as Gutspill and Nefaru. Their snarls carry through the dark shafts. Blood stains the damp earth, and those who enter face one of Duskwood's most perilous places.

sections.title: The Fall of Velinde Starsong
sections.body: Velinde Starsong, a night elven priestess, met her end deep in Roland's Doom while bearing the Scythe of Elune. The ancient artifact held immense and volatile power. Disturbed earth in the mine can stir Velinde's lingering spirit, who speaks of her final moments. Later, the terrified wanderer Jitters found the scythe there. By accident, he released more savage worgen, drawing the deadly Dark Riders to Duskwood.

faq.answer: Roland's Doom lies east of the Rotting Orchard in southeastern Duskwood. Nightbane worgen have overrun the abandoned mine.

faq.q: Why are there worgen inside the mine?
faq.answer: Nightbane worgen occupy the mine after the Scythe of Elune was lost there. Powerful beasts, including Nefaru and Gutspill, make their lair in its shafts.

faq.q: Who was Velinde Starsong and why is she connected to this place?
faq.answer: Velinde Starsong was a night elven priestess of Elune who wielded the Scythe of Elune against demons in Felwood. Her journey carried her across the sea to Duskwood, where she died inside Roland's Doom and left the scythe behind.

faq.q: How does Jitters fit into the story of Roland's Doom?
faq.answer: Jitters entered Roland's Doom and found the buried Scythe of Elune. His meddling accidentally released more worgen into Duskwood and drew the Dark Riders to the region, bringing greater peril to the forest.

angles.text: For night elves, the search for the missing priestess Velinde Starsong and the Scythe of Elune brings thoughts of their kin's fate at Roland's Doom.
As a miner, you know Roland's Doom is no place to work a pick. Bloodthirsty worgen stalk its tunnels.
